title: Dual targeting of SLC25A51 and succinate dehydrogenase selectively depletes mitochondrial NAD+ to eradicate KRAS-driven AML
authors: Ang Jia, Xiaowen Zhang, Ji-Hao Zhou, Yongcan Ma, Jing Wang, Yongbo Gong, Wenjie Song, Hangcheng Hu, Yufei Yu, Haixia Yang, Youli Lu, Linzhang Huang, Xingrong Du, Chunmei Chang, Shanshan Pei, Peng Li, Craig T. Jordan, Tong-Jin Zhao, Haobin Ye
abstract: Jia et al. reveal that KRAS-mutant leukemic cells, which express low SLC25A51 protein, are selectively killed by 615 through reducing mitochondrial NAD+. 615 simultaneously binds to and inhibits both SLC25A51, a mitochondrial NAD+ importer, and SDHA, an ETC component.
